name: StockWatch Practice
summary: Free educational web app for practising stock chart reading with blind decisions and a verdict on decision quality. Simulated data, not investment advice.

capabilities.description: 10-level learning path: candles and trend, moving averages, support and resistance, patterns, stops and R, pullbacks, breakouts, shorts, risk management.
Hidden normalized charts; decide skip / long / short with a stop and get a step-by-step verdict.
The same 5 charts for everyone each day, with a leaderboard and private groups.

policies.disclaimer: Educational practice only. Not investment advice. No real money, no trading signals or tips.
